strategy.primary: Attack and crew with Assassins, Pirates and Vehicles so Edward's end step makes a Treasure per tapped one, and Vehicle hits exile cards to play; spend the Treasure on draw and compact artifact wins.
strategy.secondary: Time Sieve extra-turn loops fed by Edward's Treasures (or Locomotive, Reaver Cleaver, Hoard Hauler), plus Malcolm + Glint-Horn Buccaneer as a second compact win.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Edward Kenway
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token for each tapped Assassin, Pirate, and/or Vehicle you control.
Whenever a Vehicle you control deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of that player's library, then exile it face down. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled.

identity.why: Treasure per tapped Assassin, Pirate or Vehicle, plus Vehicle-hit card theft.
Turns Edward's Treasure into extra turns.
Triples Treasure output into artifacts and draw.
Over-crewed Vehicle that taps many creatures for Edward.
Pirate that also steals cards on combat hits.
